archetypes.name: review-loop
archetypes.rationale: The diff replaces the inner multi-round review/apply pipeline with a single-pass state machine across several scripts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the Step 3 single-pass review flow preserves every intended terminal status, exit code, artifact write, and outer Gate-C cap behavior. Pay special attention to plan-review-loop.sh and run-step3-review.sh interactions, including panel-failed, tally-error, main-agent-vote-required, degraded collectors, cumulative OOS preservation, and stale artifact clearing. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: drift-guard
archetypes.rationale: The new cumulative drift guard introduces baseline persistence, numeric ratio logic, and merged-fence exit behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the drift-baseline and ratio logic in check-plan-size.sh and design-postplan-emit.sh. Verify write-once baseline semantics, zero-baseline handling, invalid multiple defaults, hard/partition/drift precedence, result-env forwarding, and exit 14 propagation to all retained callers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: flag-schema
archetypes.rationale: Removing --manual spans public argv parsing, run-params schema, session env, resume routing, docs, and tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether all manual_gate_b, MANUAL_REQUESTED, --manual-requested, --manual, and -m pathways were removed or intentionally ignored without leaving set -u crashes or stale schema expectations. Check parser output counts, Step 0 consumers, design-init-runparams, write-run-params, write-design-current-env, design-route resume refresh, and documentation contracts for consistency. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: pause-resume
archetypes.rationale: The diff also changes completion-sentinel and env-refresh behavior that can affect /design resume correctness.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate pause/resume and completion-sentinel semantics introduced or changed in the design skill and related harnesses. Focus on folded sentinel ordering around source-env and pause checks, resume route env refresh, stale downstream-state cleanup, and whether documented sentinel hosts match executable fences. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: log-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Log publication and security docs changed around raw prompt/reviewer artifacts and run-log surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate changes to design log publication, prompt/transcript exclusion, and security documentation for accidental publication of raw prompts, reviewer outputs, sidecars, or session-local artifacts. Check whether allowlists, tests, docs, and SECURITY.md agree on what is publishable versus session-local. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
